title: Winslow gets its own area in the Ancient Borderlands (W15, first move): searches for Winslow find our town and its guide
why: 0181 §1 gate 3. The paths run of 2026-11-27 09:51 UTC showed "We have no listings in Winslow" above 17 and 1 results, and no guide offered. The cause is data: Winslow's ZIP 86047 sits in no area (micro_clusters), so search reads Winslow as outside our areas (UniversalSearch::clusterForZips). The fix follows 0170 §2's cascade, an existing town or else a town in its zone: regions.md names Winslow in 1A, so its area goes under the zone of the Greater St. Johns Area, slug by 0042's formula. The town (anchors) follows within the hour (Guides::syncTowns), and its guide comes in E.1's ring. Tier 4 review: CEO (as CTO), 2026-11-27, Prior Ruling Check yes (0170 §2, §5, §6 and its 2026-11-27 note, 0181's W15 note, regions.md 1A, 0042), approved on seven conditions, condition 5 as 0170 §2's cascade. Tested: tools/w15-tests/winslow.php, 8 checks on MariaDB, run twice.

changes.what: Searching Winslow, AZ (or places to stay, eat or see there) finds Winslow as one of our towns, with no "We have no listings" note over its results
Winslow's area page and, within the hour, its town; its guide follows in the 1A guide ring

data_reason: Inserts one row into micro_clusters (Winslow, ZIP 86047, under the Greater St. Johns Area's zone), its id named MAX(id)+1, only if no area already covers 86047 and only if that zone is found. No other row is changed or deleted. Undo: delete that one row while nothing points to it. Check on live after publish: one micro_clusters row with slug cluster-1a-winslow.
